summary: Iteration 3 testing of VITA-FORM. 16/16 backend pytest tests passed against the public preview URL covering smoke, sources upload (TXT + PDF + bad-format), jurisprudences (admin create/search-by-q with $text score/filter-by-country/get/delete), Stripe real checkout (session+url returned, payment_transactions row inserted with status=initiated, status endpoint returns pending), generation payload validation (source_ids/jurisprudence_ids/language='ar' accepted; non-422), and email_service module (import + best-effort send to delivered@resend.dev). Frontend smoke: admin login flow works (200 + JWT in localStorage), /generator renders with all required testids (gen-language, upload-source-btn, juris-q, gen-submit, generator-form), Admin tab and admin-add-juris form present.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option value='ar'> — caused by Emergent preview's x-ve-dynamic injection wrapping inline text+expression. Cosmetic only; option still functions. Consider wrapping the conditional text in a fragment or using a single string template.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~935 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, generations.py, payments.py, sources.py, jurisprudences.py, admin.py) for maintainability before next iteration.
_call_claude masks all non-budget exceptions as 502 with raw exc[:200] — fine for dev, but consider scrubbing API keys before logging in prod.
/api/jurisprudences fallback path deletes query['$text'] then runs regex — works, but a Mongo text-index is created at startup so fallback is unlikely to trigger; safe.

Stripe webhook does NOT verify Stripe-Signature against an env webhook secret (delegated to emergentintegrations). Confirm provider validates signature; otherwise add signature verification before flipping paid=true.
Storage upload uses requests.post synchronously inside asyncio.to_thread — acceptable. 10MB cap enforced via length check after read; consider streaming for memory safety on larger files.
Generator.jsx <option value='ar'> contains both text + JSX expression — wrap in single string to avoid hydration warning.
test_credentials: admin@vita-form.com / VitaForm2026!Admin (seeded). /app/memory/test_credentials.md still references removed /api/payments/mock-checkout — recommend updating to mention real Stripe /api/payments/checkout.
seed_data_creation: Tests create + delete TEST_-prefixed sources and jurisprudences. One persistent generation row was inserted via direct Mongo for Stripe test (kept for trace); harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL https://formation-finances.preview.emergentagent.com is intermittently flaky (occasional 000 timeouts at the ingress); retry once if a network call hangs. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget appears partially exhausted — /api/generations may return 502 (LLM upstream timeout/retry) intermittently; the request validation always passes (non-422). The /api/payments/checkout/status returns payment_status='unpaid' from Stripe (we accept both 'pending' and 'unpaid' in tests). For PDF extraction tests use reportlab to generate a 1-page PDF (already implemented). Storage init requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY to be present — make sure it's loaded before bootstrap.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring fix. Hydration warning is cosmetic, caused by Emergent preview tool's dev-time DOM annotation, not a runtime issue.
